title: CI interpreter coverage and shard timing
summary: The separate Check runner capacity step measures the median of three Python loops before Run pytest. Values above 0.05 seconds refuse as ci_runner_slow with measured value, limit and recovery, retained in pytest-output.txt. When only capacity failed, item-owned rerun-failed permits failed-job recovery within three total attempts; pytest or other step failures still refuse ci_rerun_verdict. Setup precedes admission; later host degradation remains outside this check. The pytest step uses PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1.
